name: miro
validate: if (.integrations.miro // null) == null then empty elif (.integrations.miro | type) != "object" then "integrations.miro: oczekiwany obiekt {via, boards}" else ( if (.integrations.miro | has("via")) and (.integrations.miro.via as $v | ["browser", "mcp"] | index([$v]) == null) then "integrations.miro.via: niedozwolona wartosc \(.integrations.miro.via | tojson); dozwolone: browser, mcp" else empty end ), ( if (.integrations.miro | has("boards")) and ((.integrations.miro.boards | type) != "object" or (.integrations.miro.boards | to_entries | any(.value | (type != "string") or (test("^https://miro\\.com/app/board/") | not)))) then "integrations.miro.boards: oczekiwany obiekt {nazwa: https://miro.com/app/board/<id>/}" else empty end ) end
